title: Yield0x
tagline: An app that allows you to deposit unified USDC on the highest yield generating markets
description:
A DeFi app that helps you consolidating your multichain balances per token and helps you to get the higher yield on chain. We agregate DeFi lending protocols in several chains to find the best yield opportunities.

How It Works
1. SignIn using your wallet(Metamask, etc.)...
2. Initialize the Nexus SDK...
3. Check multichain balances, consolidated by token...
4. Decide which token to use...
5. We consolidate the multichain balances approving/transfering the tokens to the chain with a protocol offering the highest yield...
6. Enjoy the highest yield in town!!!!
how_its_made:
This is the tech stack:
1. Next.js/React/TailwindCSS: For frontend with a cool but professional user interface.
2. Avail Nexus SDK: Consolidating balances multichain for all the tokens user has. It was really easy to implement and use this SDK. THANKS AVAIL TEAM!!!
3. Vercel: For deployment our PoF in public. Working prototype with all the functionality from phase1 (check repository for details).
